data.name: Amaniya
data.gender_notes: Amaniya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Reliance on Allah, Assurance, Trustworthiness. The name Amaniya carries the meaning “Trust, Hope” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Amaniya usually hope their child will grow to embody trust, hope and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of faith and trust in Allah, the belief that Allah will provide and protect
data.etymology: Amaniya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trust, Hope.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amaniya total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: أمانية
in_arabic.meaning: أمانية تعني الأمن والسلام في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أمانية مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أمن' الذي يعني الأمان والسلام. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الأمن والحماية. وقد وردت كلمة 'أمن' في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ كَارِهِينَ' (التوبة: 33).

in_urdu.name: امانیہ
in_urdu.meaning: امانیہ کا مطلب ہے سلامتی اور حفاظت
in_urdu.long_meaning: امانیہ نام عربی جڑ 'أمن' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سلامتی اور حفاظت۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں وسیع پیمانے پر استعمال ہوتا ہے تاکہ سلامتی اور حفاظت کا احساس پیدا ہو۔ عربی میں 'أمن' جڑ کے متعلق قرآن مجید میں کئی آیات موجود ہیں، جن میں سے ایک یہ ہے: 'وَأَمنُ يَأْتِينَ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالرُّسُلِ وَالْكِتَابِ بِالْحَقِّ' (آل عمران: 144).

in_hindi.name: अमानिया
in_hindi.meaning: अमानिया का अर्थ है शांति और सुरक्षा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमानिया नाम अरबी मूल 'أمن' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है शांति और सुरक्षा। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है ताकि शांति और सुरक्षा की भावना पैदा हो। अरबी में 'أمن' मूल के संबंध में कुरआन में कई आयतें हैं, जिनमें से एक यह है: 'वे जो ईमान लाए और सुकून और आराम पाने के लिए (अपने हृदय में) स्थापित हो गए' (फातिर: 29).

in_pashto.name: امانیہ
in_pashto.meaning: امانيه د امن او خوندیتوب مطلب
in_pashto.long_meaning: امانيه نوم د عربي ريښې 'أمن' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د امن او خوندیتوب معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني اسلامی کلتور کې په پراخه توګه کارول کیږي ترڅو د امن او خوندیتوب احساس رامینځته کړي. په عربي کې د 'أمن' ريښې په اړه د قرآن کريم کتابت دي، لکه: 'او هغه څوک چې راسونه رالیږی د هدایت او حق دین سره' (التوبة: 33).

in_english.name: Amaniya
in_english.meaning: Amaniya means safety, security, and peace
in_english.long_meaning: The name Amaniya is derived from the Arabic root 'أمن' (aman), which signifies safety, security, and peace. This name is used in various Islamic cultures to evoke a sense of protection and tranquility. The root 'أمن' is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing its significance in Islamic tradition. For instance, 'And He is the One who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, to make it superior over all religions, even though the polytheists may detest it' (At-Tawbah: 33).

It carries a sense of calm, reassurance, and trust, making it an appealing and cherished name for Muslim families. In the Arab world and other Islamic communities around the globe, having a respected name that reflects faith and trust in God is highly valued and esteemed.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Amaniya" holds great spiritual importance to Muslims as it resonates with the belief of reliance on Allah (God). This belief is a fundamental aspect of Islamic teachings and is essential for the development of faith and devotion. Trustworthiness and faith are essential virtues for all believers and are regarded as essential traits of a good and righteous person according to Islamic teachings. Additionally, the name "Amaniya" serves as a daily reminder to seek Allah's assistance and guidance, furthering one's spiritual growth and self-improvement.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Trust, Hope" symbolizes Reliance on Allah, Assurance, Trustworthiness. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Amaniya serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of trust, hope.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Amaniya bint Wahb was a prominent female poet during the Abbasid period. The name Amaniya carried significant weight in that era.
